div.div:
[S1] CHECK_TAG
Tag comparison (ways_hits)
cache_hit = |ways_hits
s1_is_miss = s1_valid && !cache_hit
Victim select (invalid / max lru_age)
Compute new_state_cell_hit
Compute new_state_cell_miss
Port B write on hit (when s1_advancing)

div.div:
[S2] REFILL
Hit: pass-through (1 cycle)
Miss: wait ext_mem_ack_i
On ack: write cache_sram (refill)
On ack: Port B write (miss LRU)
ext_mem_req_o pulse from S1

div.div:
[S3] OUTPUT
m_valid_o = s3_valid
data_o = s3_data
hit_o = s3_hit
Hold until m_ready_i

CELL_AMOUNT = WAYS * (TAG_WIDTH + DATA_WIDTH)
ce_i,
we_i,
addr_i,
data_i,

div.div:
state_sram_model (dual-port, read-first)
─
CELL_AMOUNT = SETS
CELL_WIDTH = WAYS × (1 + LRU_CNT_WIDTH)
Port A (read): a_ce_i, a_addr_i → a_data_o
